layer_owner_check.name: layer_owner_check
layer_owner_check.value: ("layer"."owner_kind" = 'system' AND "layer"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "layer"."owner_group_id" IS NULL) OR ("layer"."owner_kind" = 'user' AND "layer"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "layer"."owner_group_id" IS NULL) OR ("layer"."owner_kind" = 'group' AND "layer"."owner_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "layer"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)

layer_schedule_check.name: layer_schedule_check
layer_schedule_check.value: ("layer"."schedule" IN ('evergreen','rolling_today')) OR ("layer"."schedule" = 'day' AND "layer"."starts_on" IS NOT NULL) OR ("layer"."schedule" = 'range' AND "layer"."starts_on" IS NOT NULL AND "layer"."ends_on" IS NOT NULL AND "layer"."starts_on" <= "layer"."ends_on")
